_schema._comment: One record per dispatched sub-task (telemetry granularity). Cycle-level grouping is derived by joining on task_id prefix, not stored separately.

fields.timestamp: string — ISO-8601 UTC, when the task was dispatched
fields.task_id: string — task graph node id, e.g. '2026-06-11T14:30:00Z-init-ranaik#node-2'
